name: RapidNative
description_en:
RapidNative is an AI-assisted builder for React Native and Expo applications. It accepts prompts, images, sketches or product requirements and describes generating screens, routing and a backend with database, authentication, storage and realtime wiring. A browser preview and a phone preview are different from a submitted app-store build.

Its current offering also connects to a separate conversion/deployment service for projects imported from other builders. Evaluate native generation, backend ownership, export and store submission as distinct steps rather than one guaranteed outcome.
description_zh:
RapidNative 是辅助构建 React Native 和 Expo 应用的AI工具，接收提示、图片、草图或产品需求，文档说明可生成屏幕、路由及包含数据库、认证、存储和实时连接的后端。浏览器和手机预览不同于已提交应用商店的构建。

当前方案还连接独立转换／部署服务以处理其他构建器导入项目。应将原生生成、后端归属、导出及商店提交分别评估，不能当作单一保证结果。

sections.title_en: Generate a small flow and test real state
sections.title_zh: 生成小型流程并测试真实状态
sections.en:
The guide starts with email sign-in and a new project, then a prompt, image, inline sketch or PRD. It describes live browser exploration, prompt or inline edits, version rollback and Expo Go/PWA previews. A generated screen may contain mock data; inspect actual signup, database writes and file uploads rather than assuming a populated preview is production data.

A pilot could create a two-screen favorites app, sign in as two disposable users and verify each user sees only their own saved items. Test an upload failure, empty state and a rollback. These are suggested acceptance checks; no app, device preview or backend policy was tested here.
sections.zh:
指南从邮箱登录和新项目开始，再选择提示、图片、内联草图或PRD，说明浏览器交互、提示／内联编辑、版本回滚和Expo Go／PWA预览。生成屏幕可能含模拟数据，应检查实际注册、数据库写入及文件上传，不能将填充预览当生产数据。

试点可创建两屏收藏应用，用两个测试用户登录并验证各自只能看到自己的保存项，同时测试上传失败、空状态及回滚。以上为建议验收，本文未测试应用、设备预览或后端策略。

sections.title_en: Annual credits are not twelve monthly bundles
sections.title_zh: 年额度并非十二份月额度
sections.en:
Starter displays USD20/month with50 credits/month, or USD119/year with450 credits granted once per year. Pro shows49/month with150/month, or199/year with1250/year. Full-stack generations are output-based rather than a flat credit per request, while other projects are described as one credit per generation. Credits reset each billing period without rollover.

Free offers20 credits/month with daily limits and five screens per project, excluding auto-added authentication screens. Running out pauses generation while existing previews remain accessible. Compare total annual allowance as well as price: twelve monthly Starter allocations would total600 credits, versus450 on the annual plan. That arithmetic is not a prediction of how many complete apps can be built.
sections.zh:
Starter显示月20美元、每月50额度，或年119、每年一次发450；Pro月49、每月150，或年199、每年1250。全栈生成按输出用量计费，不是每请求固定一个额度，其他项目则描述为每生成一次一个。额度每账期重置、不结转。

Free每月20额度，另有每日限制，每项目五屏，自动增加的认证屏除外。额度耗尽暂停生成，既有预览仍可访问。除价格还应比较全年额度：Starter十二份月额度共600，年付则450。这只是算术，不预测能构建多少完整应用。

sections.title_en: Paid export and external conversion have different terms
sections.title_zh: 付费导出与外部转换条件不同
sections.en:
Pricing says code export and commercial rights begin with a paid plan; the quick-start’s broad “download anytime” wording should be read with that condition. An imported external project rebuilt through the connected Deploy service has a separate one-time export charge. Store submission, accounts, review and service terms need their own check; app-store acceptance was not verified.

The FAQ says projects are public by default and paid users can make them private. Change and verify visibility before adding confidential material. Git integration is marked coming soon, and custom components/gluestack support are also described as in development on the homepage. Source ownership does not establish an open-source license for the platform or every generated dependency.
sections.zh:
价格页说明代码导出和商业使用权从付费套餐开始，快速入门笼统的“随时下载”应结合此条件。通过关联Deploy服务重建外部导入项目时，另有一次性导出费。商店提交、账户、审核及服务条款需另查，本文未验证商店接受。

FAQ称项目默认公开，付费用户可改私人；加入机密材料前应更改并验证可见性。Git集成标为即将推出，首页也将自定义组件／gluestack支持描述为开发中。拥有源码不证明平台或全部生成依赖都采用开源许可。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Illustrative evaluation steps were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No generated app, data-policy, native device or store review test; final service charges, licenses and export fidelity unverified.
